newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close lower on foreign selling.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close lower on foreign selling.

text.p: Delhi shares drifted to close lower as foreign institutional investors sold weighted shares despite a statement by Finance Minister P. Chidambaram that it would be difficult to raise oil prices, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index closed 4.22 points lower at 652.85.
"Share price movements were generally narrow throughout the session as operators were not ready to take risks," said Yogesh Sethi of Vinayaka Investments.
On Wednesday, Chidambaram told Reuters Television in Tokyo that it would be difficult to raise the retail prices of petroleum products.
Reliance Industries dropped 1.25 rupees to 181.25 while TISCO closed 0.85 rupees down at 154.50.
State Bank of India fell 2.95 rupees to 217.30 and TELCO quoted 4.95 rupees lower at 317.30.
Larsen and Toubro shed 0.40 rupee at 211.10 while ITC gained 1.10 rupees at 272.60.
